title: The production-readiness matrix: statuses held to the tree, hosted rows bound to the code their runs tested
note: D-2026-150 and D-2026-154. Each mutation deletes one rule of tools/readiness.py: a check of the matrix, a condition of the verdict, or a guarantee of attach(). tests/test_readiness_matrix.py breaks each rule in a copy of the shipped matrix or in a one-commit throwaway repository, and requires it refused.

mutations.name: RM1_a_changed_implementation_keeps_its_evidence
mutations.rationale: D-2026-154: a HOSTED_TESTED row stays hosted after the code the run tested has changed

mutations.name: RM2_no_implementation_is_named
mutations.find:
if not impl:
                out.append(f"{rid}: HOSTED_TESTED names no implementation "
mutations.replace:
if False:
                out.append(f"{rid}: HOSTED_TESTED names no implementation "
mutations.rationale: D-2026-154: a hosted row binds itself to nothing

mutations.name: RM3_no_runs_or_commit_needed
mutations.find: if not h.get("runs") or not re.fullmatch(
mutations.rationale: a row is HOSTED_TESTED without the runs and commit that make it so

mutations.name: RM4_locally_tested_meets_the_contract
mutations.rationale: a capability tested only locally counts toward production readiness

mutations.name: RM5_a_blocked_row_meets_the_contract
mutations.rationale: an owner action not taken does not hold the verdict back

mutations.name: RM6_attach_digests_the_working_tree
mutations.rationale: D-2026-154: the digest is taken from what is on disk, not what the run tested

mutations.name: RM7_attach_does_not_check_the_runs
mutations.find: checked = [AH.check_run(r, full, fetch or AH._gh) for r in runs]
mutations.replace: checked = [{"id": str(r)} for r in runs]
mutations.rationale: D-2026-154: a run on another commit, or not green, is recorded as evidence

mutations.name: RM8_a_row_without_implementation_is_attached
mutations.rationale: D-2026-154: attach binds a row to an empty digest
